intro: Zambia is a landlocked plateau of rivers, lakes and national parks.

chapters.title: Rivers and lakes
text: The Zambezi forms the southern border, with Victoria Falls and Lake Kariba. The Luangwa Valley is famous for walking safaris. Lakes Bangweulu and Tanganyika lie in the north.

chapters.title: Wildlife
text: Each year around 10 million fruit bats gather in Kasanka National Park.

keyTerms.meaning: Exploring wildlife on foot with a guide.
